stem:
$X$ is a random variable with probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{a}{x^2} & 1 \leqslant x \leqslant b, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $a$ and $b$ are constants.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Given that the median of $X$ is $\frac{3}{2}$, find the values of $a$ and $b$.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Use your values of $a$ and $b$ from part **(ii)** to find $\text{E}(X)$.
